probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Skip to content Dario Castelli Architect, Milan Close Projects About Journal Contact [email protected] LinkedIn Instagram Overview Show image 1 Show image 2 Casa Lario House, Lake Como, 2025 Notes Client Private client Type House Year 2025 Location Lake Como Area 240 m² Status Completed Padiglione Cervia Corte Vigentina Casa Lario The site is a narrow strip of olive terrace between the lake road and the water. The clients asked for a house that would disappear from the lake and open completely towards it. The answer is a single long volume, half board-marked concrete and half larch. From the water it reads as a low wall among the olives; from inside, one frameless window frames the lake and the mountains on the far shore. The concrete was poured with boards from the same larch that clads the house, so the grain of the wood is printed into the walls.
